title: Zara and the Three Jars

lines.text: This is Zara. She is eight years old, and every Saturday she gets $10.
lines.spoken: This is Zara. She is eight years old, and every Saturday she gets ten dollars.
lines.hero: Zara waving, the title above her

lines.text: And every Saturday, the money disappears.
lines.spoken: And every Saturday, the money disappears.
lines.hero: coins pop off one by one

lines.text: Lollies, stickers, a bouncy ball... where did it all go?
lines.spoken: Lollies, stickers, a bouncy ball... where did it all go?
lines.hero: Zara holding an empty purse, the treats scattered around her

lines.text: Then one day, Zara saw it. A rainbow kite in the shop window. $20!
lines.spoken: Then one day, Zara saw it. A rainbow kite in the shop window. Twenty dollars!
lines.hero: the rainbow kite; a price tag swings in on 'twenty'

lines.text: Grandpa! I need twenty dollars, right now!
lines.spoken: Grandpa! I need twenty dollars, right now!

lines.text: Right now? Then let's make a plan. Here are three jars.
lines.spoken: Right now? Then let's make a plan. Here are three jars.
lines.hero: Grandpa smiling, three jars on the table

lines.text: Spend, for small treats. Save, for big dreams. Share, to help others.
lines.spoken: Spend, for small treats. Save, for big dreams. Share, to help others.
lines.hero: three jar cards pop up one per word

lines.text: Put five dollars in Save every week, and watch what happens.
lines.spoken: Put five dollars in Save every week, and watch what happens.
lines.hero: the SAVE jar, camera pushes in

lines.text: Week one, five dollars. Week two, ten. Week three, fifteen.
lines.spoken: Week one, five dollars. Week two, ten. Week three, fifteen.
lines.hero: a calendar strip; the jar fills; counter ticks 5, 10, 15

lines.text: Some days Zara wanted to give up. But the jar kept getting heavier.
lines.spoken: Some days Zara wanted to give up. But the jar kept getting heavier.
lines.hero: Zara looking at the jar, tempted by the lolly shop

lines.text: I did it! And there's still money in my Share jar!
lines.spoken: I did it! And there's still money in my Share jar!

lines.text: So Zara bought her kite, and helped her friend Leo fix his broken one too.
lines.spoken: So Zara bought her kite, and helped her friend Leo fix his broken one too.
lines.hero: two kites flying over a park

lines.text: Small coins, saved with patience, become big dreams.
lines.spoken: Small coins, saved with patience, become big dreams.
lines.hero: Grandpa and Zara watching the kites

lines.text: Spend a little. Save a lot. Share with love.
lines.spoken: Spend a little. Save a lot. Share with love.
lines.hero: pull back: the three jars and the whole story

fact_notes: Fiction. Money maths checked: $10 a week = $3 spend + $5 save + $2 share; 4 weeks of saving = $20; the Share jar holds $8 after 4 weeks, which helps Leo.
All characters are invented; illustrations will be AI-generated in one cartoon style.
